setupGuideDescription.comment: Setup-guide intro paragraph: third-party keyboards must be enabled manually.

values.hanji: 手機仔系統規定第三方齒盤愛手動啟用才會當使用，請照下跤 ê 說明完成設定。
values.en: Your phone requires third-party keyboards to be enabled manually. Follow the steps below to finish setup.

setupInfoMessage.comment: Setup-guide note explaining what 'Allow Full Access' means and the privacy stance.

values.hanji: 「允准完整取用」意思是予齒盤會當捌你揤 ê 動作，成做你拍 ê 字。請放心，App 袂紀錄你 ê 資料。
values.en: "Allow Full Access" lets the keyboard recognize your key presses and turn them into the text you type. Rest assured, the app does not record your data.

setupGuideCompletedMessage.comment: Setup-guide full-screen closing paragraph: restart the app and switch via the globe key.

values.hanji: 完成了後，重開你目前使用 ê App，予 App 重掠新 ê 齒盤清單。紲落來，佇會當拍字 ê 所在，揤牢地球圖示切去台語齒盤
values.en: Once done, restart the app you are using so it reloads the keyboard list. Then, wherever you can type, press and hold the globe icon to switch to Taigi Keyboard.

freePromise.comment: About-developer page body: the maintainer's promise that the keyboard stays free.

values.hanji: 台語齒盤保證永遠免費，嘛袂做付費功能。台語是咱 ê 母語，無應該因為錢 ê 問題用袂著好家私。我向望逐家想欲學台語、寫台語 ê 人攏會當無負擔來使用，這是我做這个齒盤上重要 ê 心願。
values.en: Taigi Keyboard will always be free, with no paid features. Taiwanese is our mother tongue, and no one should be unable to use a good tool over money. My hope is that everyone who wants to learn and write Taiwanese can use it without any burden — that is the most important wish behind this keyboard.
